flagged.evidence: [F14] says the usual absolute-value distance on R is a metric and cites def-metric-space. That dependency defines a metric by its separation, symmetry, and triangle-inequality axioms; it does not verify that d(x,y)=|x-y| satisfies them. The concrete result is established in lem-real-line-is-a-metric-space, which this item does not cite.
